title: Romania Faces Twin Crises as Political Deadlock Threatens Fiscal Fix and EU… · 03 Sep
keywords: Romania, government formation, coalition crisis, deficit, fiscal consolidation, PNRR, EU recovery funds, European Commission, inflation, Romanian politics, EU funds deadline, public finances, Bucharest, EU economic governance
notes: Romania's prolonged government-formation crisis is colliding with a hard European Union deadline for its pandemic recovery funds, creating a dual pressure that threatens public finances, household living standards, and the country's standing in Brussels. With a deficit projected at 7.9 percent of GDP in 2025 and key recovery milestones due by August 2026, the window for corrective action is narrowing fast. The political mood is one of fatigue and anxiety, with little consensus in sight on who governs or who pays the bill.
